headword: {食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}

definitions.explanation: The indigestible parts of plant foods that aid digestion and promote health. A commonly discussed topic in Japanese health and nutrition contexts. Composed of 食物 (food) + 繊維 (fiber).

examples.japanese: {食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}を{多|おお}く{取|と}ろう。
{野菜|やさい}には{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}が{豊富|ほうふ}に{含|ふく}まれている。
{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}が{不足|ふそく}すると{便秘|べんぴ}になりやすい。
examples.english: A lack of dietary fiber can easily lead to constipation.

notes:
USAGE:
{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい} is a standard nutritional term frequently seen on food packaging, in health articles, and in doctor-patient conversations. It is often abbreviated to {食物|しょくもつ}せんい in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}が{豊富|ほうふ} (rich in dietary fiber)
- {食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}を{摂取|せっしゅ}する (to consume dietary fiber)
- {水溶性|すいようせい}{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい} (soluble dietary fiber)
- {不溶性|ふようせい}{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい} (insoluble dietary fiber)
